scope_note: BCL11A/Casgevy translational bridge candidate. Not part of the public canonical layer.

real_clinvar_context.interpretation: Current real ClinVar coverage does not validate enhancer-space Class B calls at BCL11A.

bridge_claim.supported: Within the known erythroid enhancer complex, DHS +58 is the most structurally sensitive enhancer and aligns with the Casgevy target region.
bridge_claim.not_supported: DHS +58 is not the single most sensitive position across the entire focused window; promoter positions are more sensitive in absolute LSSIM terms.

non_claims: Not an independent discovery of the Casgevy target
Not a public-canonical second Class B locus
Not sufficient for clinical interpretation without additional orthogonal validation
